name: Parkway Shenton
summary: GP clinic network linked to Parkway hospitals — practical for insured families who want a clear private pathway and meds continuity after HSA import.
body: Parkway Shenton clinics pair naturally with Mount Elizabeth / Gleneagles / Parkway East pathways for many corporate plans. Verify your insurer’s panel list rather than assuming every Parkway site bills identically. Use a clinic near home for ordinary illness and know which private hospital A&E your plan prefers after hours. Before elective procedures at Parkway hospitals, confirm Letter of Guarantee limits and ward-class pro-ration with your insurer so you are not surprised by a five-figure deposit desk. New arrivals who landed with HSA-approved controlled meds should book early for local refill plans — Singapore brand names and formulary availability often differ from home. Maternity packages and newborn admin are separate projects from GP registration — see the maternity and newborn-pass guides. For mental health, assume outpatient psychiatry/psychology/counselling is carved out of group medical until HR confirms otherwise — see the mental-health counselling category guide for private vs IMH foreigner-fee maths. Good fit when you want private-speed primary care without assembling a random clinic from Google Maps on day three. Private clinic networks often host or refer physiotherapy and optical partners — verify AHPC/OOB registration and whether your outpatient rider reimburses allied health separately from GP consults before bundling rehab into a package. Executive health-screening packages sold through the same group are not a substitute for MOM EP medical forms — see the health-screening & labs category guide. Dermatology and O&G referrals from a panel GP still need SMC-specialist verification and a read of outpatient carve-outs before you assume the corporate plan pays.
